string-array.name: urge_surf_stages
string-array.item: Name it. “This is a craving.” Nothing more than that.
Find where it sits — throat, chest, hands. Put your attention there.
Breathe into that spot. You are not trying to push it away.
Watch it without arguing. It is a sensation, not an instruction.
It has crested. Stay with it while it goes back down.
Still here, and it is smaller. Choose what happens next.

string-array.name: grounding_steps
string-array.item: Notice five things you can see.
Notice four things you can feel.
Notice three things you can hear.
Notice two things you can smell.
Notice one thing you can taste.
